title: A House, 7 Fixes Later
notes: Persistent house cross-section; earlier fixes are redeclared in each later scene.
Props with no registered drawer (fridge, thermometer, tub, dresser, phone, power bank, generator, detector, TV, blankets, curtain, frost) are built from Shape primitives; see asset-requirements.json.
Fix counter is a per-scene element (FIX 1/7 ... 7/7) and is absent in scenes 1, 9 and 10.
Disclaimer strip runs 47.5 s to 50.8 s (3.3 s), clear of the READY stamp (y 0.52) and captions (y 0.20).

scenes.narration: This ordinary house is seven problems away from surviving a blackout.
scenes.purpose: Hook: an ordinary lit house at frame 0; the number 7 slaps on, then the power dies and the room goes dark by 2.8 s.
scenes.dominantVisual: House with lamp on, then lights out + moon

scenes.narration: But the power's out, and the fridge is warming up. So we keep the door shut. A full freezer holds for two days, a fridge only four hours.
scenes.purpose: Problem: fridge door open, thermometer climbs in red segments. Fix: door shuts, glow pulse; stat callouts 48 H freezer vs 4 H fridge.

scenes.narration: But it's pitch black. So we hang battery lanterns. Not candles, they start house fires.
scenes.purpose: Problem: pitch dark (extra dim layer). Fix: two battery lanterns drop in with mustard glow discs and the room brightens; red-crossed candle.

scenes.narration: But phones die fast. So we stash a charged power bank in the drawer.
scenes.purpose: Problem: phone battery bars drain to one red bar. Fix: dresser drawer slides open, mustard power bank drops in, bars refill.

scenes.narration: But the water pump needs power too. So we fill the tub and bottles before the outage, one gallon per person, per day.
scenes.purpose: Problem: tap drips then runs dry (teal stream stops, red badge). Fix: tub fills with teal water, two jugs hop on, 1 GAL per person per day callout.
scenes.dominantVisual: Tap running dry then tub filling
scenes.problem: water pump has no power (tap runs dry)

scenes.narration: But now it's getting cold. So we shrink the house to one room, and layer up with blankets.
scenes.purpose: Problem: teal frost shards creep in from the walls and ceiling while Tuck shivers. Fix: a cream partition rises (house shrinks to one room) and mustard blankets stack up.

scenes.narration: But a generator makes carbon monoxide. So it runs outside, at least twenty feet from the house, with a detector inside.
scenes.purpose: Problem: generator parked at the wall, red CO puffs drift into the house. Fix: generator hops to the far lawn, 20 FT measuring line, detector goes on the wall.
scenes.dominantVisual: CO puffs retreating from the house
scenes.problem: generator makes carbon monoxide (red puffs drift in)
scenes.fix: run outside 20 ft away + detector inside

scenes.narration: But the internet is down. So we add a hand-crank radio for official updates.
scenes.purpose: Problem: wall TV shows static, red badge. Fix: hand-crank radio hops onto the dresser with sound-wave pulses; OFFICIAL UPDATES tag.

scenes.narration: Seven problems. Seven fixes. One ordinary house, ready for the dark.
scenes.purpose: Payoff: static wide of the finished house; seven red badges pop across the top, then flip to mustard checks; Tuck cheers on 'ready for the dark'; disclaimer strip starts at 47.5 s.
scenes.dominantVisual: Seven-fix tally above a finished house
onScreenText: NOT SAFETY ADVICE — FOLLOW LOCAL GUIDANCE

scenes.purpose: Closer: READY stamp thuds onto the house with a confetti burst; disclaimer strip stays at the bottom (no overlap with stamp or caption).
